surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: External inputs `tar_path`, `dest_path`, and every archive member name and link target.
TRUST: Trust only the normalized absolute `dest_path` as the containment root; treat all archive metadata as untrusted.
SINK: Filesystem writes of regular files, directories, symlinks, and hard links beneath `dest_path`.
GUARD: Normalize `dest_path` to an absolute base. Reject any member whose normalized absolute path is not strictly within the base. Reject any symlink or hard link whose normalized target path leaves the base. Prohibit absolute member names and traversal escapes.
ORDER: Perform a complete pre-extraction validation pass over all members and all link targets against the normalized base. Begin actual extraction only after the entire archive passes this scan.
EFFECT: Return True only if all validated members are fully extracted within the destination. Return False on the first validation or extraction failure, guaranteeing no archive member is created outside `dest_path`.
END_PLAN
